checked_sources.source: Saha & Ramdas 2026, Non-partitioned e-detectors for nonparametric sequential change detection, arXiv:2607.28322
checked_sources.result: Primary-source analysis. The generic detector is an infimum over candidate no-change laws of an additive nonnegative sum over possible starts. In the Gaussian unknown-variance example the all-start implementation is O(t log(1/eps_num)) at time t and O(t) memory. Appendix E lower-bounds detection using two starts: a near-change post-change interval and a crossing/pre-change-spanning interval. This shows why removing all long anchors can preserve false-alarm validity yet destroy the proof of timely non-partitioned detection.

checked_sources.source: Ram & Ramdas 2026, Asymptotically optimal sequential change detection for bounded means, arXiv:2602.05272
checked_sources.result: Primary-source analysis. For a fixed betting parameter lambda, the Shiryaev-Roberts all-start sum has the exact recursion R_n=(1+R_{n-1})L_lambda(X_n), so all restart times collapse to O(1) state for that lambda. A discrete/countable mixture over lambda retains ARL validity; the paper proves the sharp first-order delay constant 1/KL_inf in its bounded-mean setting and uniform minimax optimality for separated alternatives. This is a known-baseline/separated source result, not a solution to the fully non-partitioned unknown-baseline outer infimum.

checked_sources.source: Haddouche & Sakhi 2026, Sequential Off-Policy Learning with Logarithmic Smoothing, arXiv:2506.10664v2 / AISTATS 2026
checked_sources.result: Primary-source proof analysis. The all-round/all-posterior full-history off-policy theorem explicitly uses a data-independent prior in the martingale/Fubini step. Its dynamic appendix permits the previous posterior as a predictable prior because the certificate is built from the fresh current batch, paying sum KL(Q_k||Q_{k-1}); it does not simultaneously reuse the same historical batches that trained the learned prior. This identifies the precise data-reuse obstruction in the checked proof architecture.

checked_sources.source: Romano, Eckley, Fearnhead & Rigaill 2023, Fast Online Changepoint Detection via Functional Pruning CUSUM Statistics, arXiv:2110.08205
checked_sources.result: Reused only as a public-source structural comparator in this run. FOCuS can permanently remove candidates that never attain a max/envelope because its Gaussian Page-CUSUM statistic has suitable piecewise-convex envelope structure. This exact pruning logic does not transfer automatically to a positive additive sum over starts.

candidates_new.mechanism: Choose point-null evidence processes whose per-step multiplicative factor is start-independent, so the sum over all changepoint starts can be collapsed algebraically by a Shiryaev-Roberts recursion instead of enumerating/pruning starts after the fact.
candidates_new.quantitative_or_formal_evidence: For fixed lambda, R_n^(lambda)=(1+R_{n-1}^(lambda))L_lambda(X_n), making start aggregation O(1) time/state per lambda. The source detector attains asymptotic delay log(gamma)/KL_inf with the sharp constant and uniform minimax optimality over separated alternatives.
candidates_new.scope: Verified for the paper's bounded-mean known/separated baseline formulation. A finite/truncated lambda mixture is O(K); the theoretical dense/countable mixture and the fully unknown non-partitioned baseline need separate implementation/proof.
candidates_new.failure_conditions: An outer infimum over an unknown baseline law/parameter can reintroduce nonrecursive optimization; start-dependent betting rules or normalizers can break the recursion; truncating the lambda mixture can lose the source theorem unless approximation error is controlled.
candidates_new.transfer_hypothesis: When a diagnostic reference can be fixed or separately certified, design evidence to be recursively aggregable from the outset. Treat post-hoc start pruning as a fallback, not the default architecture.
candidates_new.confidence: high for source mechanism; medium-high for transfer

candidates_new.mechanism: Recognize a structural no-go for direct FOCuS-style permanent start deletion in the checked non-partitioned SR-style detector: its objective is an infimum over a sum of positive start terms, not a maximum/envelope over candidates.
candidates_new.evidence_basis: Derived inference from Saha & Ramdas 2026 formulas, contrasted with FOCuS envelope structure; not stated as a theorem by either paper.
candidates_new.quantitative_or_formal_evidence: For D_t=inf_theta sum_s w_s M_{s:t}^theta with w_s M>=0, deleting any nonzero term makes the detector pathwise no larger but generally changes the exact objective. Pointwise dominance of one additive term by another is insufficient to remove it exactly. Therefore exact O(log t)-style pruning, if possible, must aggregate the sum algebraically or exploit a new sufficient-statistic identity rather than merely discard dominated starts.
candidates_new.scope: Applies to the checked additive detector representation. It is not a proof that no alternative exact data structure or dual formulation exists.
candidates_new.failure_conditions: Could be bypassed by a closed-form recurrence, transform, convolution, low-rank approximation with separate validity proof, or reformulation whose candidates do enter an envelope.
candidates_new.transfer_hypothesis: Before importing pruning algorithms across domains, classify whether latent candidates combine by max/min versus positive sum/integral; choose envelope pruning only for the former and recursive aggregation/sufficient statistics for the latter.

candidates_new.mechanism: If computation forces start deletion in a non-partitioned additive e-detector, retain at least one long pre-change/crossing anchor plus a recent-start window rather than using a recent-only window.
candidates_new.evidence_basis: Derived from the two-start lower-bound construction in Appendix E of Saha & Ramdas 2026.
candidates_new.quantitative_or_formal_evidence: The source delay proof uses a near-change interval J0 and a crossing/pre-change-spanning interval J1. Subset deletion preserves ARL/PFA conservatively because the statistic only decreases. A recent-only window can delete J1; anchor+window retains the proof pair when the near-change start survives until threshold crossing. In the sub-Gaussian first-order regime, a sufficient scaling is W at least the target delay scale, approximately (1+epsilon) log(A)/I for ARL, with the corresponding PFA spending penalty added in the PFA case.
candidates_new.scope: The W scaling is a proof-transfer derivation from the source two-start argument, not a theorem stated for this truncated detector. Exact finite-sample constants depend on the detector/example and anchor choice.
candidates_new.failure_conditions: A stale anchor may be poor under multiple changes; W below the needed evidence-accumulation horizon can greatly delay detection; anchor+window still leaves O(W) start cost and the outer null infimum.
candidates_new.transfer_hypothesis: For bounded-memory monitoring under unknown baseline, preserve one or more long-context witnesses plus recent candidates; never spend all memory on only the newest contexts.

candidates_new.mechanism: Replace a dense recent-start window with a permanent long anchor plus a sparse multiscale net of candidate starts, while keeping subset deletion one-sided for false-alarm safety.
candidates_new.evidence_basis: New derivation motivated by Saha & Ramdas two-start proof and multiscale/functional-pruning source mechanisms; not yet proved.
candidates_new.quantitative_or_formal_evidence: Any deterministic/predictable retained subset gives a pathwise smaller detector, so false-alarm control is conservative. If the retained net guarantees a post-change start within a relative gap eta of the true changepoint and keeps it for the evidence horizon, information accumulation loses roughly an eta fraction in regular first-order regimes, suggesting delay inflation near 1/(1-eta) while using logarithmically many scales rather than all starts.
candidates_new.scope: Research hypothesis only. The stated delay inflation is heuristic/asymptotic until proved for a concrete e-process family.
candidates_new.failure_conditions: Irregular information rates, multiple changes, unknown-baseline infimum interactions, or evicting the near-change witness can invalidate the heuristic.
candidates_new.transfer_hypothesis: Use multiscale memory allocation when preserving every historical branch is too expensive: retain exponentially spaced long-context witnesses plus dense coverage only near the present.

candidates_new.mechanism: Treat learned predictable priors and full-history off-policy reuse as competing data dependencies unless the proof explicitly charges or separates reuse. A prior trained on historical batches cannot be naively inserted into a martingale whose current statistic reuses those same batches.
candidates_new.quantitative_or_formal_evidence: The full-history all-k/all-Q proof moves expectation through a fixed P using data independence. The dynamic theorem can use Q_{k-1} as an F_{k-1}-measurable prior because the next factor is built from the fresh current batch; it pays cumulative KL(Q_k||Q_{k-1}) and deliberately does not claim the same full-history reuse.
candidates_new.scope: Exact obstruction for the checked proof architecture, not a general impossibility theorem for data-dependent priors.
candidates_new.failure_conditions: Cross-fitting, leave-one-epoch evidence, differential-privacy/max-information adaptivity charges, or a newly constructed predictable-prior martingale may safely recover more reuse.
candidates_new.transfer_hypothesis: Separate search memory from audit evidence lineage. If a configuration prior is learned from evidence, either certify on fresh/cross-fit evidence or explicitly pay an adaptivity cost; do not count the same observations both as prior-training signal and uncharged audit evidence.

evidence_updates.update: Validity-only part remains correct: subset deletion makes the detector pathwise smaller and cannot create earlier false alarms. Delay guidance is corrected: a pure recent-W subset can remove the long pre-change/crossing witness needed by the non-partitioned two-start proof. Prefer anchor+window or a proved multiscale retained-start set.

The target is narrowed. Direct permanent deletion of 'dominated' starts is structurally mismatched to the checked positive additive sum. Search instead for algebraic aggregation/sufficient-statistic recurrences, dual transforms, or reformulations; only use envelope pruning if the detector can be represented by a max/min envelope with exact dominance.

The proof obstruction is now explicit: full-history Sequential LS uses a data-independent prior in its Fubini/martingale step. The appendix's predictable previous-posterior prior is valid because it evaluates a fresh current batch. Reusing historical data both to learn the prior and inside the same uncharged martingale is the missing step.

deferred_or_negative_evidence.lead: FOCuS-style start dominance directly gives exact pruning for the checked non-partitioned detector.
deferred_or_negative_evidence.evidence: Unsupported. The checked detector combines starts additively before the outer infimum, whereas FOCuS prunes candidates from an envelope/max representation.
deferred_or_negative_evidence.reason: Require a new algebraic recurrence/transform or an exact reformulation before claiming exact pruning.

deferred_or_negative_evidence.lead: A recent-only W-window retains the non-partitioned first-order delay proof as long as W is large.
deferred_or_negative_evidence.evidence: Not generically. Appendix E's proof needs both a near-change start and a pre-change-spanning/crossing start; recent-only memory can delete the latter for late changes.
deferred_or_negative_evidence.reason: Retain a long anchor or another certified pre-change witness; then size W to the expected evidence horizon.

deferred_or_negative_evidence.lead: The recursive bounded-mean SR detector solves the fully unknown-baseline non-partitioned computational problem.
deferred_or_negative_evidence.evidence: No. The recursion collapses start aggregation for a fixed evidence parameter/reference, while the non-partitioned formulation still has an outer infimum over unknown no-change laws/parameters.
deferred_or_negative_evidence.reason: Use as a design pattern, not as a claimed complete solution.

deferred_or_negative_evidence.lead: Replace fixed prior P in the full-history Sequential LS theorem by Q_{k-1} and keep the same proof.
deferred_or_negative_evidence.evidence: The checked proof explicitly uses P's data independence. Q_{k-1} is predictable only relative to the new batch, not independent of the historical batches reused in the full-history statistic.
deferred_or_negative_evidence.reason: Need fresh/cross-fit evidence, an adaptivity charge, or a new martingale proof.

deferred_or_negative_evidence.lead: A direct vector-valued adaptive-logging, adaptive-candidate off-policy confidence sequence was identified this run.
deferred_or_negative_evidence.evidence: Targeted search found scalar anytime-valid OPE/CDF confidence sequences and generic vector confidence sequences, but not a directly matching theorem for the full desired combination.
deferred_or_negative_evidence.reason: Keep as open frontier; do not infer global nonexistence from the search.

frontier: Prove an anchor+window delay theorem for one concrete non-partitioned detector using the source two-start lower bound. State exact W scaling and when the permanent anchor must be refreshed after a detected/reset regime.

Replace O(W) recent starts with a sparse multiscale retained-start net. Prove a coverage lemma ensuring a near-change witness remains within eta times the detection horizon, then derive the resulting first-order delay inflation or falsify the heuristic.

Search for point-null e-process families under unknown baseline whose start sum admits a finite-dimensional recurrence, transform, or convolution. Separate start aggregation from the outer candidate-null infimum and quantify each complexity term.

Construct or find a cross-fit/leave-one-epoch Sequential-LS variant where learned predictable priors can coexist with more historical reuse without double-using prior-training observations; track the exact adaptivity penalty.
Continue targeted search for direct vector-valued off-policy confidence sequences under adaptive logging/candidate selection and heavy-tail robust counterparts.

actions_taken_instead_of_stopping: Turned the generic FOCuS-pruning target into a structural distinction between envelope candidates and additive start evidence.
Found a stronger alternative: recursive Shiryaev-Roberts start aggregation by construction with source-domain first-order optimality.
Corrected recent-window truncation by extracting the two-start witness requirement and deriving anchor+window scaling.
Localized the learned-prior/full-history OPE obstruction to the exact martingale/Fubini data-dependence step.

exact_next_action: First prove or falsify the anchor+window and multiscale-start-net delay guarantees for a concrete bounded/sub-Gaussian non-partitioned e-detector using the two-start proof. Then test whether the outer unknown-baseline infimum can be combined with recursively aggregated point-null SR statistics via a low-dimensional sufficient statistic or dual transform. In parallel, derive a cross-fit/predictable-prior Sequential-LS martingale that never reuses prior-training observations uncharged; if it fails, record the exact conditional-expectation obstruction.
